title: Gas Cash — domains
summary: High-level product domains for QA. Click a domain to open its detailed flow map for Functional / Validation / Security test-case design.

nodes.label: Gas Cash
nodes.summary: Location-based on-chain game on Robinhood Chain (4663). Drive to a real gas station, pump, earn USO + $GAS.
nodes.detail: Primary UX is mobile + map + Privy social login — not a classic MetaMask/WalletConnect dApp. Click a domain node to drill into flow-level detail for TC design.

nodes.label: Auth
nodes.summary: Privy social login (Google / X / Apple), session, logout, gated pages, auth sync.
nodes.detail: Open the Auth detail map for OAuth provider branches, cancel/deny, session expiry, and security gates.

nodes.label: Wallet
nodes.summary: Embedded non-custodial wallet — balances, deposit/withdraw tabs, export warnings, sponsorship.
nodes.detail: No seed phishing in UI copy. Export is warnings-first; sponsorship is a courtesy.

nodes.label: Fund / Buy $GAS
nodes.summary: Deposit → attestation → swap into $GAS; insufficient funds; cancel; 2% tax.
nodes.detail: Money-safe QA: open flows and cancel; do not complete funded swaps unless intentional.

nodes.label: Vehicle
nodes.summary: Free bike claimed on QA; keys → open cars; lineup Starting 5.
nodes.detail: Bike grant + garage inventory observed 2026-10-26. Car buys still money-safe blocked.

nodes.label: Map / Claim
nodes.summary: Map → station → hold pump → geo/photo/refuse → payout (lab vs field).
nodes.detail: Lab shells + claimed-bike READY TO CLAIM chrome [Observed]. Full payout needs field station.

nodes.label: Garage
nodes.summary: Garage shell, Starting 5, reserves, repairs; live /garage and /pitstop.
nodes.detail: Post-claim STARTER Free BIKE; Starting 5 empty until cars [Observed]. Docs /inventory 404 vs /pitstop live.

nodes.label: Mini Mart
nodes.summary: Browse keys / prices; Coming Soon honesty; SOON/OPEN/PLAY; purchase gate.
nodes.detail: Coming-soon items must not charge as if live [Documented + Observed UI].

nodes.label: Chop Shop
nodes.summary: Merge flow + tips + empty/loading; live /chopshop vs docs /chop-shop 404.
nodes.detail: Docs say live; path honesty is a known failure mode for TC design.

nodes.label: ATM
nodes.summary: Stake 7d/30d, claim rewards, early unlock warning, My Stakes.
nodes.detail: Early unlock: penalty ≤20% shrinking; unclaimed rewards forfeited — UX must warn [Documented].

nodes.label: Social
nodes.summary: Mileage, leaderboard, referrals, privacy Public/Private + location hide.
nodes.detail: Referral claim share payout is off today [Documented].

nodes.label: Proof
nodes.summary: Prize pool, prices, contracts, chain 4663 links for reconciliation.
nodes.detail: Primary QA surface for chain truth vs UI copy.

nodes.label: Coming soon
nodes.summary: Dealership, crowbars/insurance/theft, scratchers, chat closed, Mafia Men — honesty & no-spend.
nodes.detail: Test that UI does not allow spend/claim as if live when docs say coming soon.
